name: codex-mail-bridge
description: Find and reference mail, conversations and selected original attachments from a locally configured Thunderbird account. Read its local index and MIME caches through a desktop skill and CLI.

interface.longDescription:
Developed by Cyp. Thunderbird Mail Bridge lets GPT research mail from one explicitly selected Thunderbird account on this computer. Sign in and sync needed mail in Thunderbird and allow global indexing to finish before use. Its window can be closed when an existing index/cache is available.

This local desktop plugin provides ten one-shot CLI operations through a skill. Python 3.10+ and host command/file access are required; Node.js is an optional launcher. Registered Thunderbird profiles are discovered on Windows, macOS and Linux, including Snap and Flatpak registries. No remote service, MCP server, login credentials or API key is required by the bridge. The bridge never starts a mail client or signs in.

Search the selected account by date/time, subject, body, sender, recipient or folder. Small metadata pages are the default. GPT can continue search pages, read body sections and conversations, summarize date ranges, and compare relevant original attachments or inline images. Duplicate-candidate keys, configured folder roles, body hashes and original-file receipts preserve evidence. The bridge does no PDF/Office parsing, OCR or attachment execution; the host's authorized file tools interpret selected originals separately.

Attachment search uses indexed filenames. List/get resolves one indexed message in its scoped local mbox or maildir cache and verifies its Message-ID. Missing, ambiguous or unsupported caches fail closed, without network fetching. Originals default to 10 MiB each; callers can allow up to 100 MiB when needed. At most 16 exports remain in private local storage. Release finished files explicitly; later exports or cleanup remove copies older than ten minutes. No background cleaner runs.

Mailbox access is read-only: no sending, saving drafts, deleting, moving, marking read, forced sync or policy changes. Local indexes/caches may be stale or incomplete. Only configured IMAP/POP3 accounts with a usable global search index are eligible. Synthetic regression and package checks do not establish complete server coverage or installed-host routing on every operating system.

Retrieved account details, mail and files opened by the AI host can reach OpenAI for the requested task. Local execution does not make GPT offline. There is no Cyp backend, telemetry or mail archive. Independent Cyp project; not affiliated with Mozilla or OpenAI.
defaultPrompt: Summarize all sent and received discussion about a project in my selected account.
Summarize mail received on a specified weekday and date range.
Find relevant original documents and compare their versions.
